### Honoring Church Elders
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/honoring-church-elders
Passage: 1 Timothy 5:17-18
Points:
- Paul instructs churches to provide generous financial compensation to elders who lead well.
- Those especially dedicated to preaching and teaching should be supported so they can devote themselves full-time to ministry.
- Scripture affirms this principle through both the Mosaic law regarding oxen and Jesus' statement that workers deserve their wages.
- Quoting Luke alongside Deuteronomy demonstrates that early Christians recognized the New Testament as authoritative Scripture.
- The financial care believers provide their leaders reflects how deeply they value the ministry of God's Word.
